conventions.coords: board-local top view in KiCad's sense: +x right, +y toward the FRONT edge; origin = back-left corner; back edge y = 0, front edge y = 100, left x = 0, right x = 100
conventions.rotation: KiCad footprint orientation, degrees CCW as displayed; a pad's position = pos + (x cos a + y sin a, -x sin a + y cos a) from the footprint's own pad coordinates
conventions.bottom: B.Cu parts: pads are given in the same top-view coordinates; place, then assert every pad
conventions.pads: 'pads' is the contract where fixed is true (the stack, the link, the bus and edge IDCs): a generator asserts every pad within 0.01 mm. Where fixed is false (test strips, the adapter header, every jumper) the part is placed with the board, and pos / rotation / pads record where
conventions.active_low: a doc name /X is the net label X_N
conventions.labels: every net in 'nets' is a global label of exactly this name, in both schematics
conventions.shunt: a shunt pulls its net to GND and reads 0; an open position reads 1 through 10k
conventions.nc: 'NC' = no connection; the pin is left open (no-connect flag)
